shortDescription: Binding Resource definition for describing association between appfwprofile and xmldosurl resources

options.name: alertonly
options.description: Send SNMP alert?

options.name: api_path
options.description: Base NITRO API path. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: comment
options.description: Any comments about the purpose of profile, or other useful information about the profile.

options.name: isautodeployed
options.description: Is the rule auto deployed by dynamic profile ?

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_id
options.description: The ID of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_ip
options.description: The IP of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_name
options.description: The name of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_password
options.description: The password of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_username
options.description: The username of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the profile to which to bind an exemption or rule.

options.name: netscaler_console_as_proxy_server
options.description: The IP address of the NetScaler ADC appliance acting as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: nitro_auth_token
options.description: The authentication token provided by a login operation.

options.name: nitro_pass
options.description: The password with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nitro_protocol
options.description: Which protocol to use when accessing the nitro API objects.

options.name: nitro_user
options.description: The username with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nsip
options.description: The ip address of the NetScaler ADC appliance where the nitro API calls will be made. The port can be specified with the colon (:). E.g. 192.168.1.1:555.

options.name: remove_non_updatable_params
options.description: When given yes, the module will remove any parameters that are not updatable in the resource. If no, the module will return error if any non-updatable parameters are provided.

options.name: resourceid
options.description: A "id" that identifies the rule.

options.name: ruletype
options.description: Specifies rule type of binding

options.name: save_config
options.description: If C(true) the module will save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it makes any changes. The module will not save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it made no changes.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the resource being configured by the module on the NetScaler ADC node. When C(present), the resource will be added/updated configured according to the module's parameters. When C(absent), the resource will be deleted from the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: xmlblockdtd
options.description: State if XML DTD is C(ON) or C(OFF). Protects against recursive Document Type Declaration (DTD) entity expansion attacks. Also, SOAP messages cannot have DTDs in messages.

options.name: xmlblockexternalentities
options.description: State if XML Block External Entities Check is C(ON) or C(OFF). Protects against XML External Entity (XXE) attacks that force applications to parse untrusted external entities (sources) in XML documents.

options.name: xmlblockpi
options.description: State if XML Block PI is C(ON) or C(OFF). Protects resources from denial of service attacks as SOAP messages cannot have processing instructions (PI) in messages.

options.name: xmldosurl
options.description: XML DoS URL regular expression length.

options.name: xmlmaxattributenamelength
options.description: Specify the longest name of any XML attribute. Protects against overflow attacks.

options.name: xmlmaxattributenamelengthcheck
options.description: State if XML Max attribute name length check is C(ON) or C(OFF).

options.name: xmlmaxattributes
options.description: Specify maximum number of attributes per XML element. Protects against overflow attacks.

options.name: xmlmaxattributescheck
options.description: State if XML Max attributes check is C(ON) or C(OFF).

options.name: xmlmaxattributevaluelength
options.description: Specify the longest value of any XML attribute. Protects against overflow attacks.

options.name: xmlmaxattributevaluelengthcheck
options.description: State if XML Max atribute value length is C(ON) or C(OFF).

options.name: xmlmaxchardatalength
options.description: Specify the maximum size of CDATA. Protects against overflow attacks and large quantities of unparsed data within XML messages.

options.name: xmlmaxchardatalengthcheck
options.description: State if XML Max CDATA length check is C(ON) or C(OFF).

options.name: xmlmaxelementchildren
options.description: Specify the maximum number of children allowed per XML element. Protects against overflow attacks.

options.name: xmlmaxelementchildrencheck
options.description: State if XML Max element children check is C(ON) or C(OFF).

options.name: xmlmaxelementdepth
options.description: Maximum nesting (depth) of XML elements. This check protects against documents that have excessive hierarchy depths.

options.name: xmlmaxelementdepthcheck
options.description: State if XML Max element depth check is C(ON) or C(OFF).

options.name: xmlmaxelementnamelength
options.description: Specify the longest name of any element (including the expanded namespace) to protect against overflow attacks.

options.name: xmlmaxelementnamelengthcheck
options.description: State if XML Max element name length check is C(ON) or C(OFF).

options.name: xmlmaxelements
options.description: Specify the maximum number of XML elements allowed. Protects against overflow attacks.

options.name: xmlmaxelementscheck
options.description: State if XML Max elements check is C(ON) or C(OFF).

options.name: xmlmaxentityexpansiondepth
options.description: Specify maximum entity expansion depth. Protects aganist Entity Expansion Attack.

options.name: xmlmaxentityexpansiondepthcheck
options.description: State if XML Max Entity Expansions Depth Check is C(ON) or C(OFF).

options.name: xmlmaxentityexpansions
options.description: Specify maximum allowed number of entity expansions. Protects aganist Entity Expansion Attack.

options.name: xmlmaxentityexpansionscheck
options.description: State if XML Max Entity Expansions Check is C(ON) or C(OFF).

options.name: xmlmaxfilesize
options.description: Specify the maximum size of XML messages. Protects against overflow attacks.

options.name: xmlmaxfilesizecheck
options.description: State if XML Max file size check is C(ON) or C(OFF).

options.name: xmlmaxnamespaces
options.description: Specify maximum number of active namespaces. Protects against overflow attacks.

options.name: xmlmaxnamespacescheck
options.description: State if XML Max namespaces check is C(ON) or C(OFF).

options.name: xmlmaxnamespaceurilength
options.description: Specify the longest URI of any XML namespace. Protects against overflow attacks.

options.name: xmlmaxnamespaceurilengthcheck
options.description: State if XML Max namespace URI length check is C(ON) or C(OFF).

options.name: xmlmaxnodes
options.description: Specify the maximum number of XML nodes. Protects against overflow attacks.

options.name: xmlmaxnodescheck
options.description: State if XML Max nodes check is C(ON) or C(OFF).

options.name: xmlmaxsoaparrayrank
options.description: XML Max Individual SOAP Array Rank. This is the dimension of the SOAP array.

options.name: xmlmaxsoaparraysize
options.description: XML Max Total SOAP Array Size. Protects against SOAP Array Abuse attack.

options.name: xmlminfilesize
options.description: Enforces minimum message size.

options.name: xmlminfilesizecheck
options.description: State if XML Min file size check is C(ON) or C(OFF).

options.name: xmlsoaparraycheck
options.description: State if XML SOAP Array check is C(ON) or C(OFF).
